title: Assignment Readiness | Driver Onboarding | BackOfficeFleet
description: Assignment readiness page for driver onboarding teams reviewing DQF, training, payroll setup, safety acknowledgement, and dispatch release.
html:
Driver Onboarding / Assignment Readiness

Release drivers only when the operating file can support the work.

Assignment readiness combines qualification, safety, payroll setup, training, equipment needs, and dispatch context into one release decision.

Driver OnboardingDrivers

Release decision

Ready means more than paperwork received.

The office can see whether the file supports a specific assignment, route, equipment need, and pay setup.

Release checklist

Group the required signals.

DQF status, license, medical card, MVR, training, safety acknowledgement, payroll setup, and equipment requirements are visible together.

Blocked work

Show exactly why release is delayed.

Missing document, pending review, failed acknowledgement, equipment gap, payroll setup issue, or safety owner action is assigned.
